# STADS – Students' Association for Data Analytics & Statistics Mannheim e.V.

> STADS is the student association for Data Science at the University of Mannheim, founded in 2017, with 250+ members and 30+ events per semester. It is a registered association (e.V.) and an accredited student initiative at the University of Mannheim.

STADS organizes the STADS Datathon, workshops with industry partners, guest lectures, weekly Monday Sessions, a Data Bootcamp and a Python course. Its members study diverse fields; companies can partner for recruiting, Datathon sponsorship, workshops and lectures.

## Pages

- [Home](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/): Overview of STADS and its program
- [Datathon](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/datathon): The STADS Datathon, a two-day hackathon where around 100 students solve real-world data challenges in teams
- [For Students](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/for-students): What members get and how membership works
- [For Companies](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/for-companies): Partnering with STADS (recruiting, Datathon sponsorship, workshops, lectures)
- [Events](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/events): Recurring formats: Monday Sessions, Workshops, Datathon, Guest Lectures, Data Bootcamp, Python Course
- [Our Team](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/our-team): Board and departments
- [Join Us](https://website-stads1.vercel.app/join-us): How to become a member
